Kanji through 3rd grade — 440 characters

Every kanji Japanese children learn in elementary school years 1–3, ordered from most to least common in real newspaper text. One page each.

日
1

day / sun

#1 most common1st grade4 strokesradical 日
ON
ニチジツ
KUN
ひびか

How to remember it

A picture of the sun. The old form was a circle with a dot in the middle; the brush squared the circle off, and the dot became the line inside.

Stroke order 4 strokes — grey shows what you have already drawn

Words to know

  1. 日ひday; sun
    日がのぼる。The sun rises.
  2. 今日きょうtoday
    今日は雨です。It is raining today.
  3. 日本にほんJapan
    日本に住んでいます。I live in Japan.
  4. 毎日まいにちevery day
    毎日日本語を話します。I speak Japanese every day.
  5. 日曜日にちようびSunday
    日曜日は休みです。Sunday is my day off.

How to remember it

One finger laid flat on the table. One stroke, one thing — the simplest kanji there is.

Stroke order 1 strokes — grey shows what you have already drawn

Words to know

  1. 一つひとつone (thing)
    りんごを一つください。One apple, please.
  2. 一人ひとりone person; alone
    一人で行きます。I will go alone.
  3. 一番いちばんnumber one; the most
    これが一番好きです。I like this one the most.
  4. 一日いちにちone day; all day
    一日中歩きました。I walked all day long.
  5. 一月いちがつJanuary
    一月は寒いです。January is cold.

How to remember it

A jewel (玉) locked inside a border wall (囗). A country is its treasure, kept safe inside its borders.

Stroke order 8 strokes — grey shows what you have already drawn

Words to know

  1. 国くにcountry
    どの国から来ましたか。Which country did you come from?
  2. 外国がいこくforeign country
    外国で働きたいです。I want to work in a foreign country.
  3. 国会こっかいthe Diet (Japan's parliament)
    国会は東京にあります。The Diet is in Tokyo.
  4. 中国ちゅうごくChina
    中国語を習っています。I am learning Chinese.
  5. 国民こくみんcitizen; the people of a nation
    国民には義務があります。Citizens have duties.

    三月に卒業します。I graduate in March.
  4. 三日みっかthe 3rd; three days
    三日かかりました。It took three days.

    三時にお茶を飲みます。I drink tea at three.
